item.title: Setting Up a Propeller–Wing Case in OpenFOAM: A Practical Guide to AMI
item.description: A full walkthrough of building a physically consistent propeller-wing simulation with the Arbitrary Mesh Interface: meshing, MRF, dynamic mesh setup, boundary conditions, solver controls, and force extraction, dictionary by dictionary.

item.title: Overset Meshing, Explained the Way I Wish Someone Had Explained It to Me
item.description: Why you'd bother with two overlapping meshes instead of one, and what actually happens at the boundary between them.
